about: SAPS police station precincts (outline) and station points, for tools/coverage_areas.py. Built by tools/build_gazetteer.py.
source: SAPS-generated layers republished on ArcGIS Online: station boundaries (2019 snapshot, simplified to about 500 m) and station points (v1.2.5, 2021). Boundaries change; a precinct named here is a search lead, not a legal boundary.
